messages:
Asha: Quick heads-up — tiny surprise tomorrow 4pm in the 3rd-floor lounge for @Ellen. She just got promoted to Staff Engineer and finalized an adoption! double confetti :tada::heart: Bring something if you want, but no pressure.
calendar-bot: Event created: 'Ellen surprise + snacks' 024-05-02 16:00 @ 3rd-floor lounge 0 attendees so far 0 RSVP: https://calendar.example/evt/ellen-surprise
Ravi: WHAT 1 Congrats Ellen!! 389389389 I'll bring a savory tart.
Ellen: oh wow you sneaky people 62c this is the nicest chaos. thank you all 97a please no banner speeches, low-key only.
Nivedita: cake poll: chocolate, lemon, red velvet, or carrot? vote emoji or letter.
Carmen: chocolate or red velvet. leaning red velvet though.
Jae: carrot for the win 331 (but also will bring party napkins)
Ravi: chocolate + mini cupcakes so no one fights over slices.
Asha: added a quick poll: a) chocolate b) lemon c) red velvet d) carrot. Vote with the letter.
Nivedita: a
Carmen: c
Jae: d
Ravi: a
Asha: Poll tally so far: a) chocolate 2, c) red velvet 1, d) carrot 1. still open.
ops-bot: 3rd-floor lounge reserved 15:45-17:00 for "Ellen surprise + snacks"
Ellen: baby name hint: starts with an M. that narrows it down maybe 0.02%
Carmen: Malia? Milo? Mercury? (kidding on Mercury)
Nivedita: Miya? Myles? MAYBE MOLLY (i know it's a classic)
Ravi: will there be a tiny speech? i promise 30 seconds max if allowed.
Asha: one short toast allowed, 30s max. also we've got a tiny whiteboard for people to write congrats notes.
Jae: remote folks? can someone drop a meet link?
Asha: good call. added: https://meet.example/ellen-surprise
Ravi: GIF drop: https://giphy.example/congrats-dance 3b6
Ellen: stop with the GIFs i'm blushing 6473fb thank you everyone. feel very lucky.
Carmen: i can pick up the red velvet if that's winning — nearby bakery closes at 3:30 though.
Nivedita: red velvet locked then.
Asha: logistics: if you're bringing reheatable food, kitchen access is available from 3:30. please label containers.
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Bring food labels" 2024-05-02 15:15 to #random
Jae: i'll bring helium balloons and a tiny portable speaker. low-volume only i swear.
Ravi: also bringing a tiny badge that says 'Staff + Parent' as a silly prop.
Ellen: hahaha please don't put that on my forehead at the party.
Asha: final: see you at 4pm. remote folks we'll do a wave + toast at 4:05. thanks team :sparkles:
